title: R1—R2—R3：完整诊断与复测（演示）
description: 三个阶段的合成演示：区域故障 → 邻居正常但缺路由 → 新观测通过。不能用作实测准确率或现场设备运行证明。

stages.question: 为什么 R1 使用 LoopBack0 地址 ping 不通 R3 的 3.3.3.3？

configs.R1:
#
sysname R1
#
interface GE0/0/0
 ip address 10.12.0.1 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
 ospf enable 1 area 0
#
interface LoopBack0
 ip address 1.1.1.1 255.255.255.255
 ospf enable 1 area 0
#
ospf 1 router-id 1.1.1.1
#
return
configs.R2:
#
sysname R2
#
interface GE0/0/0
 ip address 10.12.0.2 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
 ospf enable 1 area 0
#
interface GE0/0/1
 ip address 10.23.0.2 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
 ospf enable 1 area 1
#
interface LoopBack0
 ip address 2.2.2.2 255.255.255.255
 ospf enable 1 area 0
#
ospf 1 router-id 2.2.2.2
#
return
configs.R3:
#
sysname R3
#
interface GE0/0/0
 ip address 10.23.0.3 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
 ospf enable 1 area 0
#
interface LoopBack0
 ip address 3.3.3.3 255.255.255.255
 ospf enable 1 area 0
#
ospf 1 router-id 3.3.3.3
#
return
